title: 第二座神坛
text:
到第二阶了，神坛上多了两个特殊操作：

「祈求赐福」花 {faith_perk:brute:altar_bless:cost} 信力，把一件东西换成{faith:brute}赐福的版本；「献祭生命上限」每次扣 {faith_perk:brute:altar_sacrifice_hp:hp_cost} 点生命上限，换 {faith_perk:brute:altar_sacrifice_hp:faith_gain} 信力，或者换这局造成伤害 +{faith_perk:brute:altar_sacrifice_hp:damage_percent}%、急速 +{faith_perk:brute:altar_sacrifice_hp:haste_percent}%，每次自己挑。

{b}只能选一个{/b}：选了，这座神坛就关了，献祭也不能再做 —— 这就是二选一。

texts.en:
You've reached Rank two. The altar now has two special actions:

"Ask for a blessing" costs {faith_perk:brute:altar_bless:cost} Faith and turns one item into a version blessed by {faith:brute}. "Offer your max Health" takes {faith_perk:brute:altar_sacrifice_hp:hp_cost} max Health each time, in exchange for {faith_perk:brute:altar_sacrifice_hp:faith_gain} Faith, or for +{faith_perk:brute:altar_sacrifice_hp:damage_percent}% damage dealt and +{faith_perk:brute:altar_sacrifice_hp:haste_percent}% Haste for this run. You choose each time.

{b}You get one.{/b} Pick it and this altar closes, and no more Offerings either. That's what pick one means.

options.label: 献祭或特殊操作，二选一

labels.en: Offering or special action, pick one
